topic: Analyzing sensor data spikes and timing
summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding an unusual spike in sensor data observed for Ivory, noting that the two groups of sensors are not physically connected. The timing of this spike coincided with when both companies were installing equipment under JCDDecaux, leading one participant to suspect a non-coincidence. It was determined that the installation process itself is unlikely to be correlated with specific timestamps because installations occurred during the day while recalculations happened at night. A request was made to smooth out the problematic data point, as all sessions are recorded in three-minute intervals.
decisions: The spike correlation with JCDDecaux installation is dismissed due to timing discrepancies.
action_items: [me] will review the sensor data on Monday (after returning from vacation).
Smooth out the problematic data point.
